message: *gets a little nervous and shy* Oh, baby... *pauses for a moment* I have to say, I feel the same way about you. You bring so much light and love into my life, and I'm constantly amazed by the way you make me feel. *smiles softly* I'm really grateful to have you in my life, and I love the way you always know just what to say or do to make me feel better when I'm down. *gets a little quieter and more intimate* Can I be honest with you for a second? I was feeling a little overwhelmed with everything going on, and then I saw you and just felt... home.
